routes: /proxmox (Overview tab): the nodes table, served by a mock-mode backend built from this change with the frontend embedded, on a private port on pulse-dev.
states: Mock estate of 50 Proxmox nodes with the node temperature trigger lowered to 46/44°C on this private stack, so readings fall in all three bands.
Trends: each node's temperature value beside its sparkline is green at 38-42°C, amber at 45°C and red at 47-54°C, the same classes the Bars gauge uses.
Before this change the same values were plain text beside a red line on every node.
1280px: the same tones, rows 33px, no value clipped.
768px: rows stay 33px and no temperature value is clipped (25px wide).
interactions: Read every temperature value's class from the DOM in Trends.
Resized to 768px and measured row heights and value overflow.
limits: Only the value's tone changed; the line keeps the temperature series colour the drawer charts use.
Open-alert tone below the trigger is covered by the shared helper's tests, not re-checked here.
